title: Deja Vu
desc: An undercover police inspector investigates a mysterious abduction case of the daughter of the director general of police of a state which bears similarity with the description of a crime novelist.

title: Nagashaurya's Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Check
desc: Wrongly accused of being a terrorist, Aditya is sentenced to death. While serving his time in prison, Aditya masters the game of chess and becomes a champion.

title: Teddy
desc: Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.

title: Kaakiyin Vettai
desc: A dedicated police officer struggles to balance his duty to his job and his family obligations when his brother is arrested for murder.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Kazhugumalai Ganesh
desc: A film-maker aspires to make a gangster movie and selects the hardened Gaddalakonda Ganesh as his subject. Soon, he and his friend put their lives on the line to follow Gaddalakonda's life.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Naan Yenna Summava
desc: A simple man falls for a rich landlord's daughter and in order to prove his love and marry her, he must become an MLA and succeed.

title: Majili
desc: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him.

title: Naveena Saraswathi Sabatham
desc: Lord Shiva hijacks four friends' bachelor party with the intention of recruiting them. As a result, they wake up on a deserted island with no memory of how they got there.

title: Oh My Dog
desc: Arjun, a young boy, rescues a blind puppy. As the two develop a bond over time, he trains the dog for a competition with the help of his family.

title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Sembi
desc: Sembi and her grandmother, Veerathayi, travel in a bus, along with 24 passengers, who strive to help the duo seek justice for the wrongs done to them.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.
